parameters.description:
Grafana's hosted MCP server exposes dashboards, datasources, alert rules and incident context as tools, and can run queries against the datasources your account can reach — so an assistant can check whether a metric actually moved instead of asking you to go and look.

Bring your own token: create a Grafana service account token (`glsa_…`) and store it as GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN. Make a dedicated service account with the Viewer role rather than reusing an admin one — these tools can query datasources, and a datasource query is only as safe as what that account is allowed to read.

Enrol and the tools appear in your client prefixed `grafana__`, reached through the one UnitySVC MCP endpoint you already configured.
parameters.summary: Query Grafana dashboards, datasources and alerts from your AI client.
